typography.pairing_descriptor: System UI stack (-apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto) — no Google Fonts, warm and readable, no decorative typefaces

subjects: physical collections on warm wooden surfaces (vinyl, books, DVDs)
barcode scanning in action on Android phone
collector lifestyle at record fairs or charity shops
imagery.composition: warm tones, soft natural lighting, uncluttered flat-lay style, cozy home environment

brand_values: privacy first — data stays on device
no-nonsense simplicity — no account, no ads, no fuss
one-time fairness — €4.99 once, never a subscription
respect for physical media and collecting culture
accessibility for all ages — works for non-tech users

target_audience.profession: hobbyist collectors of books, vinyl records, DVDs, CDs, and games
pain_points: buying duplicates at record fairs, charity shops, or book markets
losing track of large collections (300+ items)
apps that require accounts, cloud sync, or constant internet
subscription fatigue — paying monthly for something that should be simple
intimidating tech that requires setup and passwords
aspirations: know exactly what they own before buying anything new
organize their entire collection without tech hassle
shop smarter at fairs and second-hand stores
keep their collection data private and offline
find a simple tool that just works
